newsitem.title: USA: Designer, Donna Karan negotiate amendment.
newsitem.headline: Designer, Donna Karan negotiate amendment.

text.p: Designer Holdings Ltd said Monday it was negotiating with Donna Karan International Inc to amend its licensing agreement to make and distribute DKNY jeans.

Designer also said the design, production and shipment of "some portions" of the DKNY Jeanswear lines would be delayed "due to unexpected difficulties that have arisen between Donna Karan International and the Company".
The lines were due for the fall season.
On September 27, Designer paid about $60 million for the exclusive rights to the lines, an amount that some investors considered to be too big.
A spokesman for the company declined to explain what difficulties Designer was having with Donna Karan and how long a delay they would cause for the release of the lines.
Donna Karan officials were not immediately available for comment.
